runs.text: Six countries. Their number one baby name is Hebrew. Germany, two thousand and twenty five: the top boy's name is Noah. Austria: Noah. Switzerland: Noah. The Netherlands and Belgium: Noah again. France: Gabriel. Noah means rest, in Hebrew. Gabriel: God is my strength. And number two? In America and England, Noah again. America's top ten also has James, from Jacob. Mateo means gift of God. Elijah: my God is the Lord. That's four of America's top ten. All from the Hebrew Bible. And Hebrew is still spoken today, on every street in Israel. Not everywhere, though. Italy's number one is Leonardo. What does your name mean? Tell me in the comments. If you like Israel facts, follow <<n|oʊ|ˈ|ɑ|m>> <<ˈ|r|ɑː|z>> for more. So, which language names Europe's babies?
